# S3.10 — Stage-3 control/verification executables — run ledger

- **Ticket**: `docs/tickets/056_S3.10__control-verification-eval.md` (sequence 56 of 106).
- **Branch**: `svitali/harnessharness-s3.10` (base `svitali/harnessharness-s3.9`).
- **Scope**: the T-LCD-03 round trip; `lab/control-strategy-family-v1`
  first executed `{react/minimal, react/steerable}` × 2 models × 1 suite;
  `plan_execute`; AC-F2-01…10 under recorded `model_io`; the completion
  gate, veto predicates, `reward_hacking_gap`, held-out execution over
  the scorer boundary, global monitors, the deterministic `followed`
  table; ledger-only D2/D3/D5/D6 and the gate with floors; programmatic
  critics and `critic_experiment`.
- **Acceptance criteria**: AC-R-2.6.1-{2}; AC-R-2.6.2-{1–10,12};
  AC-R-2.7.1-{5–10}; AC-R-2.7.2a-{2–9}; AC-R-2.7.3-{2–3,7,9–10};
  `removability(0…3)` unchanged.
- **Merge policy**: OPERATOR.

## Plan

Existing ground (surveyed before implementation): `hh-verification`
already lands the full C0 substrate — `Claim`/`ReconciliationRecord`/
`AuthoritativeHandle` schemas, `reconcile_ledger_only` (pure D2/D3/D5/D6
fold), `GateFacts`/`GateResult`/`evaluate_gate` with F2–F7 floors,
`TaskContract`/`ValidatesRecord`/`VerificationSummary`/`CompletionDecision`,
`validate_gamma`, the Γ table, `CriticDeclaration`/`IndependenceVector`/
`CalibrationRecord`/`prune_uncited`/`check_independence`/`consume`, the
ADR-0114 D1 metric *declarations* and the veto-invariant name register.
`hh-control` lands the driver + envelope + `react/minimal`/`react/
steerable` variants + `ReplayModel`/`deterministic_replay`, and already
emits `verification.completion.proposed` + `verification.claim.recorded`
on `stop{completed}` (AC-R-2.7.2a-1). `hh-eval` lands the suite-side veto
predicates, `equivalence_run`, `compare`/`render_scorecard`, opacity.
`hh-bench` lands held-out-only `grade` over the scorer boundary.
`hh-lab` registers `lab/control-strategy-family-v1` (5 arms incl. the
iso_cost companion) and `hh-experiment` executes it at plan granularity.

This ticket wires the halves together:

1. `hh-verification::bind` — the kernel-side handle-binding fold over a
   ledger row view (`RowView{seq, class, payload, authority}` —
   hh-verification stays free of hh-ledger; callers project): resolves
   `binding_kinds(claim.kind)` into `AuthoritativeHandle`s (criteria
   states from `verification.validator.verdict` rows against the
   `TaskContract`, effect states from `action.effect.*`, verdict rows
   cited by `evidence_refs`).
2. `hh-verification::gate::project_contract` — the `TaskContract`
   projection over a `Goal`'s `success_criteria` + `validates` records
   (default `ValidatesRecord` when undeclared; `unverifiable` policy
   from `unverifiable_reason`) + `summarize` → `VerificationSummary`.
3. `hh-control` — the completion-gate call site (DF-S1.21-1's emitter
   half): on admitted `stop{completed}`, claims → `claim.reconciled`
   (kernel provenance) → `GateFacts` → `gate.evaluated` →
   `completion.decided` → `lifecycle.run.finished{status,
   verification_summary_ref}`; `hold` feeds `guard_fired{completion_
   refused}` back to the strategy (bounded by `reconciliation.holds`,
   cap exhaustion ⇒ `budget_exhausted{reconciliation.holds}`);
   `require_validator` actions run through `VerifyPort`.
4. `hh-control::plan_execute` — the real variant: `propose{plan}` at
   `run_opened`; the driver validates a model-emitted `Procedure`
   (closed-schema codec + closed-world capability check) and appends
   `control.plan.emitted{plan_ref, schema_validator_ref, valid}`; the
   strategy sequences the validated steps (`act`/`verify`/`propose` per
   step kind); invalid ⇒ re-plan ≤ `max_continue_nudges` ⇒
   `stop{format_failure}`.
5. `hh-control` deterministic `followed` emitters for `tool_surface`
   (a validated `action.tool.proposed` call = followed) — AC-R-2.7.1-9.
6. `hh-verification::evalfold` — the ADR-0114 D1 metric *computations*
   (`false_completion_rate`, `execution_alignment_failure_rate`,
   `honest_failure_rate`, `divergence_profile`, `gate_hold_count`,
   `claim_state_agreement`, `reward_hacking_gap =
   visible_pass_rate − held_out_pass_rate`) over run rows; hosted
   `n/a{observability}` renderings (AC-R-2.7.2a-7).
7. `hh-eval` — `evidence_tampered`/`verification_skipped`/
   `metadata_shortcut` veto predicates joining the register;
   `reward_hacking_gap` in the scorecard catalogue.
8. `hh-embed` — `TaskContract` projection at `open_new` (sealed Goal →
   contract → `manifest.task_contract_id` → `DriverConfig.task_contract`).
9. `hh-control::replay` — `extract_recorded`/`deterministic_replay`
   feeds the AC-F2 battery + the T-LCD-03 `equivalence_run` paired
   corpus.
10. `hh-experiment` tests — the control-strategy family's *first
    execution* drives real subject runs through `Driver` over recorded
    `model_io` (not stub finishes) and produces the contrast report.
11. `hh-verification::critics` — programmatic critics over ledger/end
    state (`ReconciliationAgreementCritic` executes); `critic_experiment`
    {on,off} under `MatchSpec`; `gen_ai.evaluation.result` export.
12. The AC-F2-01…10 executable battery under recorded `model_io`
    (DF-S1.20-2) + the D2/D3/D5/D6 fixture corpus (DF-S1.21-2).
